hotel_name: The Hotel Am Bliss Sector 43 Gurgaon

positive_snippets:
This is one of the best budget hotels I have ever come across that offers absolute premium experience in every aspect.     You get the maximum bang for your bucks that makes you yearn to visit again.
The entire property is well-maintained.   And tastefully done.
The rooms are lavish and spacious and offer great view from the balcony.   You get your own quiet and peaceful space far away from the outside noise.
The food here is though a tad expensive, it's always fresh and hygienic.    The staff is very prompt and is always ready to heed to your requests.

As the name suggests, this hotel offers absolute , pure Bliss that you would look for after you return from your day's work.

I hope to visit here soon.

A wonderful stay
in AM Bliss Downtown is my go to for a little staycation! It’s built near a lot of great markets and restaurants however the food at the hotel is amazing as well! The hotel staff is always very welcoming and always greet you with a warm smile.

"My stay at this hotel was excellent. The room was clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. The staff and faculty were very polite, helpful, and always ready to assist with a smile. Overall, a wonderful experience – highly recommended!"
